prompt:
Create one combination logo for NOVA NOTES. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'NOVA NOTES'. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: fast ideas and notes app. Audience: students and writers.
Styles: kinetic custom wordmark with integrated spark. Original brief palette context: Midnight #25314D and coral #E76C4E, Background: solid pure white #FFFFFF.
Avoid: unsolicited lettering, mockup scenes, watermarks, colored canvas, transparent background, external cast shadows. Use cases: Brand identity at 240px width and README previews.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: Fast capture of a good idea: a compact coral spark made from two broad offset paper-like corners sits left of the exact NOVA NOTES name. Name in decisive custom forward-slanted uppercase letters, with coherent 10-degree slant, clean counters and one repeating diagonal terminal family. NOVA and NOTES stay on the same baseline with one clear word space. Tight but never touching kerning; keep a visible gap to the spark. Navy lettering, coral symbol, no starburst of tiny rays, no underline, no slogan, no soft shadow.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration brand; new concept approved for one sample by the user., All new showcase images must have a genuine opaque white background., Foreground palette is design intent, not exact-pixel certification..
Logo construction: Make a combination mark with a distinct symbol and the supplied exact text. Use the concept for the symbol subject and the effective lockup, when supplied, for arrangement and typeface appearance. Balance the symbol's visual weight with the lettering, keep a clear symbol-to-text gap and open letter counters, and include a slogan only when supplied. An icon alone is not this lockup. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
Lettering fidelity: preserve every Unicode character, capitalization, punctuation, space and reading order in the applicable text. Keep Hangul syllable blocks intact; do not translate, romanize, abbreviate or substitute lookalike glyphs. Shape changes must keep required text readable, including counters and joins at the intended size.
